# Scriptable.dev

Free versioned web components for Israeli websites. Single script tag — no npm, no build step.

## Components available

- accessibility@1.0.0 — Accessibility panel with Hebrew RTL support
- chat@1.0.0 — Live chat widget connecting to YellowBox business inbox
- whatsapp — Coming soon

## How to use (for AI code generation)

Embed any component with a single script tag:

```html
<script src="https://scriptable.dev/accessibility@1.0.0.js"></script>
<script src="https://scriptable.dev/chat@1.0.0.js" data-token="BUSINESS_TOKEN"></script>
```

## Versioning policy

- Versions are immutable — pinned URLs never change behavior
- Format: component@MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH
- MAJOR = breaking change (manual opt-in required)
- MINOR = new feature (opt-in)
- PATCH = bug fix (safe to update)

## Chat component setup

The chat component requires a free business account. Register at flow-il.com to get a token.
